evals.prompt: Create an HTML presentation for an internal Metis strategy session. It should be 5 slides covering: 1) Cover slide titled 'AI Operating Model Workshop', 2) Agenda with 4 items, 3) A three-phase approach slide showing Discovery, Design, and Delivery phases with activities under each — use tabs so the audience can click between phases, 4) A key findings slide with 4 numbered callouts that animate in when the slide appears, and 5) Next steps. Use Metis branding. Make it interactive and visually engaging.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with 5 slides using Metis theme colors (navy, mint, gray). Should use tab-group component for phase details, animate-in on the callouts, hover effects on cards, keyboard navigation, and all CSS inlined.

evals.prompt: I need an HTML deck using the Parker Hannifin template at C:\Users\Andrew Krusell\Downloads\UNTITLED (2).pptx as a brand reference. Make it 3 slides: a cover, a slide showing a before/after comparison of their current vs AI-enabled quoting process, and a slide with a connected process flow showing 4 steps where each step has a click-to-reveal detail panel. Extract their brand colors from the template. Add slide transitions between slides.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with 3 slides using Parker brand colors (navy/gold). Should use before-after and connected-process CSS components with clickable-reveal on each step. Slide transitions via data-transition attribute. Single portable file.

evals.prompt: Build me a quick HTML presentation for a capability assessment. I need: cover slide, a slide with an accordion showing 4 capability areas that expand to reveal details when clicked, a heat map maturity assessment slide with animated count-up metrics at the top, and a pull quote from a client executive. Metis branded. Use hover effects and entrance animations throughout.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with 4 slides using Metis theme. Should use accordion component, heat-map-table, count-up animation on metrics, pull-quote, hover-lift on interactive elements, and animate-in/animate-fade on content. Tables should be well-formatted with proper tier colors.
